document.role: sealed V0.3 failure and unchanged C1/C2 evidence

goal: Act as a fresh-context scientific and algorithm-design reviewer before any V0.4 counterfactual source outcome is generated. Determine whether this is a defensible attempt to make the third Catfish independently improve final ratio-of-sums energy efficiency, while preserving exactly three independent Q functions and one deployment argmax.
authority: Treat every document as a proposal or evidence record, not as a conclusion you must accept. Inspect the referenced implementation and tests directly. The physical C3 target is fixed as the opening-slot non-focal rate externality; C1/C2 are unchanged. No TEST or V0.4 EE result exists. Do not edit files or run source generation/training.

review_questions.question: Does the lagged beam/satellite victim-rate burden causally expose information that can predict the unchanged zeta3 target without current-action, outcome, or future leakage?
Is route-local state at deployment coherent: Q1/Q2 use the V0.3 view, Q3 uses the V0.4 view, their surfaces are summed, and exactly one masked argmax is used?

Does the pre-outcome selector/scheduler avoid target cherry-picking while addressing the old 40/30-state replication failure? Identify any hidden selection bias, support mismatch, or impossible 28-action constraint.

Is positive held-out Q3 learnability genuinely plausible from the supplied evidence? Separately, is positive marginal EE effect versus drop-C3 plausible, and what interaction could still make it fail?

Is there a materially simpler or more causally direct design that preserves the user's invariant of three Catfish, one per Q network, each intended to improve EE? Compare it with the proposal rather than merely listing alternatives.
Find implementation/spec mismatches, unit errors, double counting, stale V0.3 assumptions, or missing gates that should block fresh source generation.

success: Return a decisive recommendation: GO_SOURCE, GO_AFTER_BOUNDED_FIXES, or NO_GO_REDESIGN. Support it with file/line evidence. Separate (a) confirmed facts, (b) scientific inference, and (c) claims that only the fresh learnability or 500EP EE screen can establish. List every blocking fix; if none, say none. Estimate confidence qualitatively for learnability-positive C3 and EE-positive C3 separately. Keep the report concise and focused on decision-changing findings.
boundaries: Read-only review. Do not modify files. Do not generate outcomes, train, open TEST, or infer efficacy from passing unit tests. Do not preserve a mechanism merely for narrative symmetry; effectiveness and causal validity dominate.
